author: thatxepicxrelik
quote: even on the best possible console and television it makes no sense for this game to have screen tearing and be locked at 30fps, gta 6 was highly anticipated with a high budget and in return for patience they spat in your mouth, you cant steal a majority of cars, npcs freak out if you carjack them, cops are superhuman and teleport where ever you are if the story so calls for it yet are blind if you arent doing the story, sure the game looks nice but is that all they spent the budget and development on??? its a nothing burger and I feel like I wasted both my time and money
